notes:
Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS building in-app assistant + document search for product teams. Currently using OpenAI API for embeddings + chat; want lower unit cost and stronger SLOs. Evaluation track: Hosted API first -> Dedicated if throughput/cost targets met.

Sales/AE notes (Diego):
- Interest started after ROI analysis: expected 30-45% token cost reduction with caching + batching.
- 'We need model parity with our prompts; cannot accept drift.' — Head of ML (A. Brennan).
- Security team: must prove KMS integration + SOC2 evidence. Data residency preference: US-only for sensitive product telemetry.

POC specifics:
- Scope: migrate two endpoints (support-chat and doc-search embeddings) to Redwood Hosted; measure latency, token cost, quality on 10k prompt/response pairs.
- Success metrics: <120ms p50 latency for chat backend (payload trimmed), embedding cosine recall >= baseline (OpenAI) within 1.5% MAP, total token cost <= 0.7x incumbent.
- Tools: will run Redwood SDK alongside existing calls using canary routing (20% traffic), collect evals.

Early findings (internal SE notes):
- Prompt parity issues: system prompt handling differences -> short-form answers more concise on Redwood causing 4% drop on our QA metric.
- KV-cache and batching show promising cost reductions in synthetic tests.
- One regression case: reranker changed top-1 result on 18/2k queries; needs prompt tuning and model variant fallback.

Stakeholders: Head of ML (A. Brennan), Eng Manager (L. Cho), Security Lead (M. Grayson), Procurement (R. Patel).

Comms / artifacts:
- Fireflies meetings: ffX_2026-02-11 (intro & architecture), ffX_2026-03-02 (POC q/a).
- Drive: pricing deck + security questionnaire shared. Gmail threads listed above.

Deal dynamics / pricing:
- Looking for committed capacity scenario if POC meets targets. Mid-market pricing band targeted; initial commit ~ $60-120k ARR.
- Procurement pushing for 12mo renewal with business SLAs for latency/uptime.

Sales playbook actions done:

- SE deep-dive 2026-02-25: ran comparative eval harness; captured token/time metrics.

Open questions / risks:
- How to guarantee prompt parity across model variants (quantized vs full precision)? Need runbook for regressions + automated evals.
- Legal: IP/data retention terms — procurement flagged 3 items.
- Timeline risk: incumbent contract through June could delay close.

Recommended next steps (from AE/SE):
- 2026-03-17 POC kickoff with infra: install Redwood canary SDK, enable KV prefix cache, run 10k sample sweep.
- Deliver Dedicated pricing and SOW by 2026-03-20.
- Create regression alert set in Redwood Optimize for prompt parity (top-10 QA tests).
